description: A public company's equity incentive (stock and incentive compensation) plan document, as filed or published for stockholders

plan_name.description: The full title of the plan as printed at the top of the document

former_plan_name.description: The plan's previous title, if the document says it was formerly titled something else

company_name.description: The legal name of the sponsoring company, from the definition of 'Company'

state_of_incorporation.description: The state in which the company is incorporated, from the definition of 'Company'

restatement_date.description: The amendment and restatement date printed under the plan title, as written

eligible_participants.description: The classes of person eligible to receive awards, from the Eligibility section (e.g. Directors, Employees)

award_types.description: The types of award the plan permits, from the definition of 'Award'

share_reserve.description: The share pool and share-counting rules from the section on shares subject to the plan

total_shares_reserved.description: The maximum number of shares that may be issued under the plan

incentive_stock_option_limit.description: The maximum number of shares that may be issued on exercise of Incentive Stock Options

full_value_award_ratios.description: How many shares each share issued under an award other than an Option or Stock Appreciation Right counts as against the reserve, for each period stated

shares_counted.description: The number of shares counted against the reserve for each full-value share issued, e.g. 1.69

period_start.description: The date the ratio applies from, as written

period_end.description: The date the ratio applies until, as written. Leave empty (JSON null, not the text 'null') when the ratio applies from its start date thereafter with no end date

option_sar_shares_counted.description: How many shares each share issued under an Option or Stock Appreciation Right counts as against the reserve

director_annual_award_limit.description: The maximum aggregate grant-date fair value, in US dollars, of awards to a Director in any one fiscal year

minimum_vesting_period_years.description: The minimum vesting or performance period for awards, in years

minimum_vesting_carve_out_percent.description: The percentage of the share reserve that may be granted free of the minimum vesting requirement

option_max_term_years.description: The maximum term of an Option, in years from the grant date

ten_percent_holder_iso_max_term_years.description: The maximum term of an Incentive Stock Option granted to a 10% Stockholder, in years

ten_percent_holder_iso_min_price_percent.description: The minimum exercise price of an Incentive Stock Option granted to a 10% Stockholder, as a percentage of Fair Market Value

sar_max_term_years.description: The maximum term of a Stock Appreciation Right, in years from the grant date

share_par_value.description: The par value per share of the common stock, in US dollars

fair_market_value_exchange.description: The stock exchange whose closing price defines Fair Market Value

change_in_control_ownership_threshold_pe.description: The percentage of total voting power whose acquisition by a person or group triggers a Change in Control

clawback_policy_name.description: The name of the company clawback policy that awards are subject to

governing_law.description: The state whose laws govern the plan

last_grant_date.description: The date on or after which no award may be granted, from the Term of Plan section, as written

approving_meeting_date.description: The date of the stockholders' annual meeting at which the restated plan becomes effective on approval, as written
